title: Unit-level aggregation breaks coverage in causal foundation models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal foundation models (CFMs) show promising results for treatment-effect estimation, with unit-level estimates that are competitive on standard benchmarks. Many causal analyses, however, inform decisions through effects averaged over groups of units, such as the full sample, the treated units, or a subgroup, and for such decisions a CFM is useful only if its credible intervals are calibrated. We examine these intervals and find that their coverage degrades, both in simple synthetic settings and on standard benchmarks. On ACIC 2016, for example, temperature-calibrated 95% intervals from CausalPFN fall below nominal coverage beyond groups of 30 out of 4802 units, and intervals for the full-sample average contain the true value in only 20% of datasets. translated_title: 单元级聚合破坏因果基础模型的覆盖率
translated_abstract: 因果基础模型（CFMs）在处理效应估计方面展现出可喜的成果，其单元级估计在标准基准测试中具有竞争力。然而，许多因果分析是通过在单元组（如全样本、受处理单元或某个子群）上求平均的效应来为决策提供依据的，对于这类决策，只有当CFM的可信区间经过良好校准时才有用。我们检验了这些区间，发现无论是在简单的合成环境中还是在标准基准上，其覆盖率都会退化。例如，在ACIC 2016数据集上，CausalPFN经温度校准的95%区间，一旦对4802个单元中超过30个单元的组进行聚合，其覆盖率便低于名义水平，而全样本平均值的区间仅在20%的数据集中包含真实值。我们将这一问题归因于这些模型的训练方式及其区间的构造方式：它们一次只输出单个单元的预测分布，并在推理时将这些……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 因果基础模型虽然在单元级估计上表现出色，但其可信区间在聚合到单元组（如全样本平均效应）时会严重退化，在ACIC 2016上全样本平均效应的区间仅有20%覆盖真实值。
en_tdlr: Causal foundation models achieve competitive unit-level treatment-effect estimates, but their credible intervals suffer severe coverage degradation when aggregated over groups of units, with full-sample average intervals covering the true value in only 20% of ACIC 2016 datasets.
